newsitem.title: GREECE: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) REDUCES GASOLINE PRICES.
newsitem.headline: PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) REDUCES GASOLINE PRICES.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) will reduce gasoline prices by 0.80 drachmas per litre, effective on Thursday.
But transport diesel prices will be raised by 1.20 drachmas per litre, DEP said.

The price adjustments come after lower world gasoline prices, down by $4.0 per metric tonne, higher diesel prices, up by $4.0 per metric tonne, and a firmer dollar/drachma exchange rate, up 0.71 drachmas per $, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
